items.claim: Thrallo remains a pinned genuine Code OSS workbench with native explorer, editor, search, SCM and terminal.
The D9 home, launcher, navigation, conversation, typed plan card, agent activity, model selector, usage and run presentation execute against deterministic providers.
D8 recent workspaces, framework/Git state, native folder launch, terminal and import review are coordinated from the D9 product surface without upload.
D9 consumes D1 and D3 fixture/read contracts through the packaged shared client; it contains no live transport or default origin.
Production conversations, plan decisions, agent controls, model selection, builds and canonical project association remain blocked until Track B contract freeze.
Cloud workspaces, preview, deployments, domains, database, integrations and visual editing are labelled future capabilities and are not implemented by D9.

visualVerification.browserBlocker: The in-app browser controller rejected the local inspection session because sandbox policy metadata was unavailable.
